editorialRead.headline: Morning Read — October 17, 2026
editorialRead.readHeadline: aaif-goose/goose is the first source to inspect.
editorialRead.oneLineSummary: aaif-goose/goose leads a 3-item attention queue backed by direct receipts; 29 watchlist sources are fresh, 0 need source-health attention, and movement still requires editorial judgment.
editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 29 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.
bullets: aaif-goose/goose — 1 commit today and 1 same-day mapped article, 4 below its current daily pace, with 1 hardening-subject points. Inspect the receipt before assigning a story.
openclaw/openclaw — 216 commits landed today. Keep it on watch, but require the next receipt to prove a reader consequence before promoting it.
Kilo-Org/kilocode — No same-day commit after 279 commits in the seven-day window. The pause is notable enough to preserve, not enough to turn into a story.
editorialRead.watchNext: The next meaningful upgrade is feedback flow: issues opened and closed, review latency, stale backlog, and the share of work that starts outside the maintainer team.
editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: Watch the release boundary for Goose’s code-mode replacement
dailyInsight.insight: Goose has merged a Boa-based replacement for PCTX while preserving tool discovery and batching. The latest checked stable release, v1.55.0, still uses PCTX.
dailyInsight.mechanism: Original JSON schemas and exact-name tools.call dispatch replace generated TypeScript namespaces. Scripts run in fresh contexts while Goose continues to own external tool operations.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: Recipe authors can prepare for a changed execution interface, and maintainers can evaluate the removal of V8-specific build work without assuming the installed release has already changed.

actions.audience: Goose recipe authors and integrators using code mode
actions.label: Identify instructions that depend on the old interface
actions.instruction: Review one existing recipe for execute_typescript, generated namespaces or PCTX-specific facilities. Wait for a containing release, then compare that workflow in a disposable setup before changing production instructions.
actions.effort: One recipe review now; one bounded migration trial when released

receipts.title: Boa replaces PCTX in code mode
receipts.supports: Retains discovery and batching with a new script interface and removes V8-specific dependencies and build workarounds.

receipts.title: v1.55.0 still selects PCTX
receipts.supports: The stable tag has not adopted the merged Boa dependency.

confidence.basis: Pinned implementation, baseline, upstream tests, review discussion and stable-tag dependencies inspected; no runtime migration trial executed.

dailyInsight.limitation: The author’s small synthetic comparison does not isolate engine performance. Heap allocation remains unbounded, and Nix/RISC-V builds were not exercised in the change.
dailyInsight.falsifier: A containing release changes or withdraws the new calling contract, or a fixed-workflow trial shows the intended tool composition no longer works.
dailyInsight.watchNext: A containing release and a reproducible real workflow comparison including completion, permissions and interruption.
